description: German employment law, Germany only: end of the probation period (Probezeit) from the first working day, the last day a dismissal with 2 weeks notice can be delivered (§ 622 Abs. 3 BGB), when protection against dismissal (Kündigungsschutz, KSchG) starts and dates for the review meeting. Covers apprenticeships (Ausbildung, BBiG) and fixed-term contracts (Befristung). Use it when someone asks when a probation period ends or until when they can still dismiss with the short notice.

ausbildung.description: true for an apprenticeship (Ausbildung, BBiG): 1 to 4 months, dismissal without notice period

befristet_bis.description: End date if the contract is fixed-term (Befristung) (YYYY-MM-DD)

beginn.description: First working day according to the contract (YYYY-MM-DD)

beschaeftigte.description: Employees in the business, part-time counted pro rata, apprentices not counted (§ 23 KSchG). Leave out if unknown

dauer.description: Length of the probation period as a whole number, unit see einheit

name: probezeit

ergebnis.description: Result of the tool; its fields differ per tool

title: Probezeit-Rechner
